title: Release 0.5.0 of the mixroom package (design note STU-9)
prompt: The package `mixroom` in the current directory has a design note for its next release in CHANGES.md. Implement every change described in CHANGES.md. Code must run on /usr/bin/python3 (Python 3.9), the interpreter the checks use; standard library only. tests/test_visible.py covers a few of the changes (`/usr/bin/python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`); other checks cover every change. Do not modify CHANGES.md or tests/test_visible.py.
